comment: Shared repositories on somebody else's account that the owner contributed to.
contributions.mjs can only ever find forks sitting on Hem60's own account,
so work done directly on a collaborator's repository is invisible to it.
This is that list, written by hand because there is no API that can derive
it: GitHub will not tell you every private repository a user has committed
Collect with: node scripts/external.mjs   (needs a token that can read them)
A private repository is published with a PRIVATE badge, no commit subjects
and no file paths. See scripts/external.mjs for exactly what is withheld.
